goal: Create an original typography-free concept-poster visual plate with one unmistakable graphic anchor and protected zones for later deterministic copy.
audience: Cultural-program designers who need a reusable, brand-neutral visual-first poster workflow

content.subject: One monumental upright folded vermilion-paper ring framing one small pale interior disc in a floorless ultramarine space
must_include: Exactly one complete folded vermilion-paper ring with a clean circular opening
Exactly one small pale moon-like disc visible through the opening
A calm unbroken deep-ultramarine zone in the top 20 percent and bottom 14 percent for later typography
Visible paper fibers, crisp folded edges, restrained pressure creases, and a plausible grounding shadow
Vertical poster hierarchy: ring first, interior disc second, shadow and texture third
must_avoid: People, hands, animals, buildings, landscapes, products, mockups, logos, brands, or recognisable artwork
Letters, numbers, readable text, pseudo-text, labels, QR codes, signatures, or watermarks
Extra rings, extra discs, ribbons, stars, props, borders, grids, captions, or collage panels
Generic glossy 3D rendering, neon cyberpunk, retro kitsch, clutter, copied campaign aesthetics, or source-derived wording
Cropped ring, malformed circular opening, implausible paper folds, or contradictory light and shadow

art_direction.style: Contemporary tactile editorial print culture with an original restrained sculptural visual
art_direction.lighting: One soft directional studio key with gentle fill, yielding believable fold and grounding shadows

composition.layout: Vertical 2:3 poster with one slightly low central ring and deliberately calm top and bottom text-safe zones
composition.viewpoint: Straight-on editorial view with a small amount of depth to make paper structure and shadow legible
focal_hierarchy: One pale disc through the opening
Plausible shadow, paper fibers, and restrained print grain

objective_checks: Output is exactly 1024x1536 PNG/RGB without alpha
No visible text, logo, brand, signature, or watermark appears
Exactly one folded ring and one pale interior disc appear
visual_checks: The ring is complete, structurally coherent, and visibly made from one folded paper material
The ring, disc, and shadow establish a clear calm poster hierarchy
Top and bottom zones remain practical for later deterministic typography
The limited palette and print texture feel intentional without generic 3D, neon, retro, product, or copied-campaign aesthetics
